sn17.30:1.2: yopi so bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo tassapahaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ antarāyāya vadāmīti.
sn17.30:1.3: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn17.30:1.4: kissa pana bhante khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno lābhasakkārasa iloko antarāyāyāti.
sn17.30:1.5: yā hissa sā ānanda akuppā cetovimutti nāhaṃ tassā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ antarāyāya vadāmi.
sn17.30:1.6: ye ca khvassa vo 3 ānanda appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato diṭṭha dhammasukhavihārā adhigatā tesāhamassa lābhasakkārasilokaṃ antarā yāya vadāmi.
sn17.30:1.7: evaṃ dāruṇo kho ānanda lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
sn17.30:1.9: uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
